## ITAM

### Storytelling in Economics

::: {.eyebrow}
Master in Applied Economics · Spring 2025
:::

Two questions run through the course: how economic narratives spread and move
real outcomes, and why some arguments take hold within economics itself while
others don't. The anchor text is Robert Shiller's
[*Narrative Economics*](https://press.princeton.edu/books/hardcover/9780691182292/narrative-economics).
From there, the practical craft: structuring an argument, choosing what to show,
designing tables and figures that carry the point, and writing for policy
audiences. Materials are public.

- [Syllabus (PDF)](files/storytelling-syllabus.pdf)
- [Slides (ZIP)](files/storytelling-slides.zip)
